module: Flowgraph node "Get Player Vehicle ID" (provider category). Outputs: vehId (number) id of the vehicle controlled by the player (be:getPlayerVehicleID(0), -1 if none) and exist (bool, hidden). Old pin name: objID -> vehId (legacyPins).

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by _flowgraph_createNode(C)). The methods are called by the flowgraph manager or the editor.

work.desc: Writes vehId = be:getPlayerVehicleID(0) or -1 and exist = (vehId ~= -1).
